name: The New World (1492)
_doc: Authored starting conditions as data (B10): the opening seeds the state tables from this scenario. nation/difficulty are picked at the new-game screen; everything else (map, year, starting gold, colonies, units) is here. Colony coords are snapped to the nearest land tile at load. Unit 'type' resolves through @UNIT (row index == type id). Each colony has colonists (workers) and built buildings: a worker is a colonist with a profession (@JOB id), a good (0..7 raw tile good / 16 Hammers / 17 Crosses / 18 Bells), and a ring tile (0=NW..7=SE, -1 = building slot); a tile worker's terrain is derived from the map at that ring tile so yields reflect the real map. Production (food/bells/hammers/crosses/goods) is COMPUTED from these each turn, not seeded. buildings = built @BUILDING ids.
